outcome: Incidence of iron deficiency anaemia at the time of delivery
Complications defined by the hospital discharge complication coding system
Number of blood tests carried out antenatally per trimester
cohort: Patients presenting for elective caesarean section over a two-year period
finding: 16.2% of patients undergoing elective caesarean section had iron deficiency anaemia, and this was associated with ethnicity, BMI, age, and parity.
